hint.en: Font ROM from a BBK A4980 device. Keep the original name 8.BIN, including its case.
hint.zh: 来自步步高 A4980 的字体 ROM，文件名必须保持为 8.BIN（区分大小写）。

hint.en: OS ROM from a BBK A4980 device. Keep the original name E.BIN, including its case.
hint.zh: 来自步步高 A4980 的系统 ROM，文件名必须保持为 E.BIN（区分大小写）。

hint.en: Font ROM for the A4988 model; only needed when bbkemu_model is set to a4988.
hint.zh: A4988 机型的字体 ROM；仅当核心选项 bbkemu_model 设为 a4988 时需要。

hint.en: OS ROM for the A4988 model; only needed when bbkemu_model is set to a4988.
hint.zh: A4988 机型的系统 ROM；仅当核心选项 bbkemu_model 设为 a4988 时需要。

notes.en: Runs .gam dictionary games on a 159x96 LCD. Requires 8.BIN and E.BIN firmware for the model selected in Core Options (a4980 by default) under BIOS/bbk/<model>/. A is Enter, B is Exit, Y is Help, X is the R key, Select is Insert and Start is Search.
notes.zh: 运行 .gam 电子词典游戏，屏幕为 159x96。需要所选机型（默认 a4980）的 8.BIN 与 E.BIN 固件，放在 BIOS/bbk/<model>/ 下。A 为确认，B 为退出，Y 为帮助，X 为 R 键，Select 为插入，Start 为查找。
